A '''memory mask''' was a [[Helmet/Legends|mask]] that the wearer could change its shape. When he [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|faced]] his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] aboard the ''[[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|Harbinger]]'' over [[Phaegon III]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saes Rrogon]] placed a [[Color/Legends|white]] memory mask in front of his face, and it took on the shape of an [[Erkush/Legends|erkush]]{{'s}} [[Bone/Legends|skull]], one of [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]]'s largest [[Diet/Legends|predators]].<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>
